title: The LOST Poster Has My Face
premise: In our town, if the LOST poster on the corner shows your face you've got one week, and when mine went up my whole family treated me like I was about to go missing.
twist: 'Lost' was about the town pie contest: on Saturday at eleven I lose to Grandma for the first time in six years by two points, and she'd painted her victory banner on the very Sunday my poster went up.
world: A sunny town: a wooden notice board on a street corner with cream LOST posters carrying a red question mark and a drawing, Mom's kitchen, a card room, Grandma's kitchen and a white-and-red striped pie tent on the green.
